# orchestra_pipelines (Data Source)

Pipelines in the workspace, optionally filtered by name. All matching pages are fetched.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every pipeline whose name contains "sales". All pages are fetched.
data "orchestra_pipelines" "sales" {
  name = "sales"
}

output "sales_pipeline_aliases" {
  value = [for p in data.orchestra_pipelines.sales.pipelines : p.alias]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Filter by a case-insensitive substring match on the pipeline name.
- `page_size` (Number) Items fetched per request (1-100, default 100). Every matching page is fetched regardless; this only tunes the request size.

### Read-Only

- `pipelines` (Attributes List) Matching pipelines, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pipelines))

Read-Only:

- `alias` (String) The pipeline alias.

- `name` (String) The pipeline name.
- `num_tasks` (Number) Number of tasks in the pipeline.
- `paused` (Boolean) Whether the pipeline is paused.
- `product_id` (String) Product the pipeline belongs to.

- `webhook` (String) Summary of the pipeline's webhook trigger.
- `yaml_path` (String) Path to the pipeline YAML file.
